exposure: 48-hour oral cephalexin and metronidazole antibiotic prophylaxis post-cesarean
standard of care (no additional post-cesarean prophylaxis)
cohort: The study included 397 patients with obesity (BMI >30 kg/m2) who underwent cesarean delivery.
finding: Post-cesarean antibiotic prophylaxis with oral cephalexin and metronidazole for 48 hours in patients with obesity was associated with a significantly reduced incidence of surgical site infections (SSIs) and no hospital readmissions within 60 days compared to standard care.
